initial_failure.cause: host/device tile mismatch in the first experimental patch caused shared-memory under-allocation and an illegal CUDA memory access

corrected_candidate.compiler_error: static assertion failed with nwarps*tile_C::I != mmq_y

conclusion: The current MMA kernel couples 8 warps to a 128-row accumulator tile. Reducing mmq_y alone is invalid; it requires a coordinated tile_C and warp-mapping redesign.
